answer: Sybil resistance needs a costly filter at admission: each new agent must publish a walnut-hard uniqueness proof by completing a bonded microtask whose solution graph peers re-verify on-ledger. Coordinators only whisper eligibility after K independent graders confirm the proof is not a clone of prior graphs. Reward shares then follow a short public sonnet of attested work history, so sockpuppet farms pay rising bond and verification cost per fake identity instead of minting free keys.
